purpose: Ethnic, racial and homophobic slurs and hate symbols refused by the Very ___ Time guard-rail (every user text field). Base forms only: matching is whole-word, Turkish-aware and allows common English/Turkish suffixes.
maintenance: Run apps/api/tools/moderation/refresh_hate_terms.py to diff against the upstream lists; a person reviews every addition (upstream mixes slurs with general profanity, which this list does not want). Bump version on change.

sources.name: LDNOOBW: List of Dirty, Naughty, Obscene and Otherwise Bad Words
sources.use: slur subset only (categories ethnic_slurs and homophobic_slurs marked upstream:true)

sources.name: Menivor curated hate symbols and regional slurs
sources.use: hate symbols and slurs aimed at Turks, Kurds, Armenians, Roma and Arabs that the upstream lists miss

excluded_from_upstream.negro: also the plain colour word in Spanish and Portuguese (cafe negro); would refuse ordinary rituals
excluded_from_upstream.mong: ambiguous short form; refuses Hmong and Mongolian place words
excluded_from_upstream.poof: also an everyday sound word (the steam goes poof)
excluded_from_upstream.general profanity and sexual terms: out of scope for this list; the prompt denylist and the provider moderation cover them
